'''Del''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] who served in the [[Brak Sector Force]]. He was one of the new recruits assigned to [[Oracle Base]] after [[General/Legends|General]] [[Trep Reskan]]'s force allied with the Rebel Alliance.
